readingOrder.text: Measuring Drift in Long Reading Sessions
We describe a small observational study of attention drift
Reading a research paper is rarely a linear activity.
Earlier work on reading interfaces has mostly measured speed
We restrict attention to papers typeset in a single column
We use the word session for one uninterrupted sitting
Each participant read one paper of about twenty pages
Here the sum runs over all jumps in a session
Drift score over time for one representative session.
Twelve graduate students took part. Each chose a paper
